natātiō resupīna

Examples

  • 1lutra: short u (Lewis & Short lūtra, without evidence). De Vaan 355: from PIE *ud-ro- “of the water”, with the short u of Sanskrit udrá- and Greek ὕδρος; Italian and Portuguese lontra and French loutre continue a short u. Lewis & Short’s etymology, luō, has a short u too. Ruling: lutra with a short u.

    Resupīnus natā, sīcut lutra.1

    Swim on your back, like an otter.composed

Other words

  • natātiō retrōgrada — backstroke

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. swimming

See also breaststroke, front crawl, swimming.

SourcesLewis & Short: resupinus · Lewis & Short: retrogradus
